items.between-tokens: a comment is allowed wherever white space is
items.contents: quotes and other characters inside a comment

items.case: upper and lower case are different
items.long-names: names longer than eight characters are accepted
items.eight-significant: only the first eight characters are significant
items.runtime-names: a program may use any non-keyword name, including the compiler's support routine names

items.reserved: keywords cannot be used as identifiers

items.octal-8-9: digits 8 and 9 in an octal constant have value 10 and 11
items.auto-long: a constant too large for int (decimal) or unsigned (octal, hex) is long

items.is-int: a character constant has type int

items.forms: integer part, fraction, exponent in every allowed combination

items.array-null: array of char with a terminating null
items.distinct: all strings, even identical ones, are distinct

items.fundamental-types: char, int in three sizes, unsigned, float, double

items.lvalue-required: a non-lvalue on the left of = is rejected

items.char-to-int: char used where int is allowed

items.pointer-integer: an integer may be added to a pointer

items.mixed-with-int: the int operand is converted to unsigned

items.long: if either operand is long the other becomes long
items.unsigned: otherwise if either is unsigned the other becomes unsigned

items.array-to-pointer: an array name becomes a pointer to its first element
items.call-implicit-int: an undeclared function is assumed to return int
items.call-char-promoted: char and short arguments are passed as int
items.call-float-promoted: float arguments are passed as double
items.call-many-args: many arguments, nested calls as arguments

items.cast-constant: a cast applied to a constant converts it

items.pointer-plus-int: integer is scaled by the object size
items.pointer-minus-pointer: result is a count of objects

items.result-type: the result has the type of the left operand

items.result-wide-operands: the result is int for long and double operands too

items.pointer-null: a pointer may be compared with 0
items.precedence: lower precedence than the relational operators
precedence of & ^ | against == and each other

items.short-circuit: right operand not evaluated when the left decides

items.one-evaluated: only one of the second and third is evaluated
items.conversion: usual conversions give a common type

items.simple: the value is that of the left operand
items.conversion: right operand converted to the left type
items.lhs-once: E1 op= E2 evaluates E1 once

items.value: type and value of the right operand
items.in-argument: parenthesized comma expression as one argument

items.register-no-address: & of a register variable is rejected

items.short-long-unsigned: short, long, unsigned with and without int
items.default-int: a missing type specifier means int
items.unsigned-other: unsigned char, unsigned short, unsigned long (not in K&R, common extension)

items.self-reference: pointer to the structure being declared
items.tag-reuse: a tag used for later declarations
items.union-size: big enough for the largest member
items.field-zero: width 0 aligns to the next word
items.field-truncation: assignment truncates to the field width
items.member-namespace: V7: members with the same name in different structures

items.size-from-init: array size taken from the initializer
items.default-zero: static and external default to zero

items.type-names: abstract declarators in casts and sizeof

items.function-pointer: typedef of a pointer to function
items.redeclare-inner: a typedef name redeclared in an inner block

items.dangling-else: else goes with the nearest if

items.for-omitted: any of the three expressions omitted

items.no-match: no match and no default does nothing

items.break: leaves the nearest loop or switch

items.return: with and without a value, converted to the function type

items.goto: forward, backward, out of nested loops, into a block

items.float-param: float parameter is adjusted to double

items.static-file: static data and functions private to the file

items.inner-extern: extern in a block reaches the external
items.tag-in-block: structure tag declared in a block
items.label-scope: labels belong to the whole function

items.forward-reference: use before definition in the same file
items.multiple-files: one definition shared by several files
